legend: Sharply circumscribed hypocellular tumour with a hyalinized matrix containing slit-like spaces and blood vessels.
copyright: Elder DE, Massi D, Scolyer RA, Willemze R, editors. WHO classification of skin tumours. Lyon (France): International Agency for Research on Cancer; 2018. (WHO classification of tumours series, 4th ed.; vol. 11). https://publications.iarc.fr/560.

legend: Bland fibroblasts and slit-like capillary vessels within a hyalinized matrix.
Example showing foci of increased cellularity, with constituent spindle cells arrayed in a fascicular to storiform growth pattern resembling nodular fasciitis.

A circumscribed, multinodular lesion composed of dense collagenous tissue with a variable number of plump grey epithelioid fibroblasts. There are admixed foamy macrophages, mild chronic inflammation, and haemosiderin; giant cells are not seen.
